name: November 18, 2025 Parks and Recreation Commission - Notice of Location Change
agenda_text:
Notice of Changed Meeting Location
  Parks and Recreation Commission
  Regular Meeting
  Tuesday, November 18, 2025

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the regularly scheduled meeting of the
Malibu Parks and Recreation Commission for Tuesday, November 18,
2025, at 6:30 p.m., has changed meeting location from the Multipurpose
Room to the City Hall Chambers.

The meeting was originally scheduled to be held in the Multipurpose Room at
23825 Stuart Ranch Road. However, due to unforeseen damage to the
Multipurpose Room resulting from the recent rain event, the meeting location
has been changed to the Council Chambers at 23825 Stuart Ranch Road.

Should there be any questions regarding this notice, please call the City Clerk’s
Office at (310) 456-2489, ext. 228 or email cityclerk@malibucity.org.

Dated: November 16, 2025, at 9:30 a.m.

__________________________________
Brittany Saleaumua, Administrative Assistant
